episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father’s murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he initiates his struggle against Nah-Lin, a Native American who he believes has stolen his inheritance. Diego will confront the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all. In doing so, he will sacrifice his love for Lola.

episodes.name: Inheritance
episodes.plot: To attract Zorro's attention, Diego and Lolita are held hostage in a robbery at the loan office. Lolita gets injured and Diego questions whether he is up to the task of wearing the mask.

translations.value: To attract Zorro's attention, Diego and Lolita are held hostage in a robbery at the loan office. Lolita gets injured and Diego questions whether he is up to the task of wearing the mask.

episodes.name: The Bet
episodes.plot: A woman is missing in Chinatown, calling Zorro to take action. Matters get worse with the unfortunate explosion at the Ramirez mine. Additionally, Diego learns the painful news of the murder of his father.

translations.value: A woman is missing in Chinatown, calling Zorro to take action. Matters get worse with the unfortunate explosion at the Ramirez mine. Additionally, Diego learns the painful news of the murder of his father.

episodes.name: Revenge
episodes.plot: Zorro is instilling fear in an open war against the governor. Lolita is torn by her emotions for Diego while Monasterio unveils something about Zorro that is going to change everything.

translations.value: Zorro is instilling fear in an open war against the governor. Lolita is torn by her emotions for Diego while Monasterio unveils something about Zorro that is going to change everything.

episodes.name: The Execution
episodes.plot: Monasterio suspects that Zorro is not what the governor claims him to be. Diego and Nah-Lin feel forced to leave behind their differences and strike a truce to free the captured indigenous people. Diego uncovers a crucial clue to find his father’s murderers.

episodes.name: Mask Games
episodes.plot: The auction for Ramirez’s lands seems to have a pre-fixed winner: The Russo-American company. Right after attempting to avoid Andreyévich from making the auction, Diego is surprised by the visit of the Bear Clan. Lolita is confused with her feelings for Diego and her engagement with Monasterio.

episodes.name: The Myth
episodes.plot: Accounts of Zorro appear in The Californian, which helps Ivanova find the missing piece to her plans. Diego gets a final warning from one of Nah-Lin's men that puts at risk his secret identity.

episodes.name: The Wedding
episodes.plot: Nah-Lin discovers that Lolita is Diego’s weakness, so she threatens to kill her on her weeding day if he doesn’t give up being Zorro.

translations.value: Nah-Lin discovers that Lolita is Diego’s weakness, so she threatens to kill her on her weeding day if he doesn’t give up being Zorro.

episodes.name: Unmasked
episodes.plot: The Bear Clan asks Diego for a loyalty test. If he wants to prevent it, he must uncover the murderers before the established deadline. Lolita confronts Diego about Zorro’s identity.

translations.value: The Bear Clan asks Diego for a loyalty test. If he wants to prevent it, he must uncover the murderers before the established deadline. Lolita confronts Diego about Zorro’s identity.

episodes.name: The Three Funeral Mask Dance
episodes.plot: Guadalupe and Samael arrive in Los Angeles to claim part of Alejandro’s inheritance. The deadline is almost over: Diego must kill Monasterio.

overview.value: Diego de la Vega torna in California per vendicare l'assassinio del padre. Dopo aver assunto il titolo di Zorro, inizia la sua lotta contro Nah-Lin, un nativo americano che crede gli abbia rubato l'eredità. Diego affronterà il Governatore, il malvagio leader della comunità cinese e di una società segreta, anteponendo il bene comune a tutto. Nel farlo, sacrificherà il suo amore per Lola.

Dopo aver assunto il titolo di Zorro, inizia la sua lotta contro Nah-Lin, un nativo americano che crede gli abbia rubato l'eredità. Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father's murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he confronts the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all.

Diego de la Vega es elegido para ser el nuevo Zorro, pero su único propósito es desenmascarar a los asesinos de su padre y llevarlos ante la justicia. A medida que asume el papel de Zorro, Diego no solo lucha por la justicia en Los Ángeles, sino que también descubre los desafíos de ser un héroe y cómo su papel afecta a California en el siglo XIX.

overview.value: Diego de la Vega torna in California per vendicare l'omicidio del padre e assume il titolo di Zorro, il giustiziere mascherato che aiuta i deboli e gli indifesi, stretti nella morsa dei colonizzatori della California, degli oligarchi russi e dei francesi.
